objective: Research a distinct post-flush recovery regime for Pump and Pons assets that remain structurally healthy after Current/Survivor momentum failure, without loosening either existing strategy.

initial_research_universe.pump: verified Pump.fun lineage on canonical PumpSwap after graduation/migration, including Current rejects and Survivor non-qualifiers
initial_research_universe.pons: verified Pons graduation lineage on canonical post-graduation market, including Current rejects and Survivor non-qualifiers
initial_research_universe.note: Start with post-graduation/migration evidence where structural survival and executable liquidity can be measured cleanly.

thesis: A prior directional thesis may fail without the asset becoming structurally invalid. A sufficiently deep flush followed by selling exhaustion, liquidity/breadth retention, stabilization and fresh recovery demand may create a new independent opportunity.
required_evidence_categories: liquidity retention and executable exit depth

structural_survival: hard concentration remains acceptable or improves
selling_exhaustion: sell pressure decelerates from flush peak
new lows stop expanding for a measured interval
recovery demand is not creator/linked-wallet dominated
recovery_confirmation: price recovers a policy-defined reference such as VWAP/base boundary
executable capacity remains positive after costs

conflict_rules: Research observation may continue while Current or Survivor has exposure, but reset-recovery allocation authority remains false.
If promoted later, one asset/family cannot hold duplicate Current, Survivor, and Reset exposure unless an explicit future shared-sleeve conflict policy authorizes it.
Existing Current/Survivor positions and irreversible exit intents always retain their native lifecycle authority.
A Current or Survivor rejection is context only; reset-recovery must qualify from its own fresh evidence.
promotion_evidence_requirements: A prospective, outcome-blind sample of natural reset candidates.
Enough executable shadow outcomes to estimate winner capture and loser admission separately.
Evidence that the regime adds incremental opportunities rather than mostly duplicating Survivor.
Positive after-cost expectancy with bounded drawdown under frozen thresholds.
No threshold search on the same sample used for final acceptance.
Exact policy identity, restart/replay, shared-sleeve and accounting certification before any PAPER allocation.
